content.short: Diffuse combines zkTLS and trusted execution environments for trustless private computation.
content.description: Diffuse pairs zkTLS with trusted execution environments so that computation over private data can be verified without the data being revealed. The combination matters for bringing off-chain facts on-chain: a proof that a web response said something specific, without publishing the response itself.
content.meta: zkTLS paired with trusted execution, proving a computation without revealing what went into it.
